content.title: Trump Accounts Are Coming in 2026. What It Means for You.
content.summary: Trump Accounts are coming—and they could provide a big boost to the stock market.  Formerly known as a MAGA Account, a Trump Account is nothing more than a tax-deferred savings vehicle for children under 18, restricted to U.S. index-tracking mutual funds and exchange-traded funds.  The initiative has its roots in the One Big Beautiful Bill, and has been styled as a way to provide Americans with exposure to the stock market starting from birth.
